name: Mahou Shounen Bloody Mary
original_name: 魔法少年ブラッディメリー
source:
In order to exterminate the Hell Prisoners that overflow from Hell and collect the "Fragments of the Gate of Yomotsu", Meimu transforms into a magical boy by using the magical scissors, "Phantasmagoria". Although he's reluctant to, Meimu steadily fulfills his obligations; that is, until one day, a colossal Hell Prisoner appears before him...!?

Translated from [url=https://zypressen.sakura.ne.jp/xxx/contents/bm1-index.html]source[/url].
translation:
为了消灭从地狱溢出的地狱囚徒并收集“四毛之门碎片”，美梦使用魔法剪刀“幻影”变身为魔法少年。尽管心里不情愿，美慕还是踏踏实实地履行了自己的义务；也就是说，直到有一天，一个巨大的地狱囚徒出现在他面前……！？

翻译自 [url=https://zypressen.sakura.ne.jp/xxx/contents/bm1-index.html]source[/url]。
